definitions.explanation: A man who manages the household as his primary role, typically while his spouse works outside the home. The male counterpart of {主婦|しゅふ}, which shares the same pronunciation but a different first kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主夫|しゅふ}として⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧している。
examples.english: My husband handles the housework as a househusband.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧{主夫|しゅふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more men are choosing to be full-time househusbands.

notes:
{主夫|しゅふ} was coined as the gender-neutral counterpart to ⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧ (housewife) — same reading, with {夫|ふ} (husband) replacing {婦|ふ} (wife). It remains far less common than ⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧, since full-time homemaking is still mostly done by women in Japan, but its use has grown as more men take on the role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧{主夫|しゅふ}: full-time househusband
- {主夫|しゅふ}{業|ぎょう}: homemaking, done as a househusband
- {主夫|しゅふ}になる: to become a househusband

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧: housewife, homemaker — the far more common counterpart; same reading, different kanji.
